data.title: 佩丽卡 · 星图低回的指挥官特权
data.action: 站在全息星图前，单手摘下战术耳机，烟蓝长发垂在露出的优美背沟上，回头望向管理员，神色严谨中带着一丝罕见的局促。
data.location: 终末地技术探索指挥舱，淡蓝色的行星地貌全息云在空气中缓缓旋转
data.lighting: 全息星图散发幽蓝冷光，勾勒出修长的肩颈与后背弧度，地面泛着金属光泽
data.mood: 铁血总监私下独处时的知性反差，克制与心绪波动的微妙平衡
data.description: 终末地技术探索指挥舱，淡蓝色的行星地貌全息云在空气中缓缓旋转。站在全息星图前，单手摘下战术耳机，烟蓝长发垂在露出的优美背沟上，回头望向管理员，神色严谨中带着一丝罕见的局促。 她微微抬眸轻语——“非勤务时间的着装规范并没有违反终末地协议……管理员，请不要用做任务简报的眼神看着我。”
data.promptProse: Standing before a glowing planetary star chart on the darkened Endfield command bridge during a quiet jump cycle, Perlica wears a minimalist slate-blue nano-mesh deep-V crop bustier with carbon-fiber straps and boyshorts. Slipping her tactical headset off with one hand as she glances back over her shoulder with restrained shyness, she is outlined in cool holographic blue light.
data.animaCaption: Standing before a rotating blue planetary hologram on the dim command bridge in a slate-blue nano-mesh crop bustier and boyshorts, she lowers her headset with one hand and looks back over her bare shoulder with composed, faint shyness. Cool holographic blue light traces the curve of her back.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a sleek slate-blue nano-mesh deep-V crop bustier trimmed with black carbon-fiber straps and matching fitted boyleg shorts.
